description: This file provides utility functions to determine if a value is a Zod schema and to convert such schemas into JSON Schema format. It integrates with the 'zod-to-json-schema' library for schema transformation and handles plain objects or null/undefined inputs gracefully.

methods.name: function isZodSchema(value: unknown): value is ZodType { isZodSchema
methods.description: Checks whether the provided value is a Zod schema by inspecting its internal structure, specifically looking for Zod's '_def' property or the '~standard' property with vendor 'zod'.

methods.name: export function toJsonSchema(schema: unknown): Record<string, unknown> { toJsonSchema
methods.description: Converts a given schema to JSON Schema format. If the input is a Zod schema, it uses 'zod-to-json-schema' to perform the conversion. If the input is already a plain object, it returns it unchanged. Handles null or undefined inputs by returning an empty object.

ctags.name: obj
ctags.pattern: /^  const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;$/
